title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Company Overview

BeomyTech is a dynamic technology company based in Israel, focused on the development of innovative solutions. Our projects require rapid prototyping, a high degree of flexibility in adopting new technologies, and the integration of artificial intelligence throughout the software development lifecycle.
 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Engineer to work on end-to-end product development in an English-speaking team. The role involves building modern web applications and contributing to advanced AI-driven systems.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript
  • Backend: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM
  • AI: AI agents, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, vector databases
     

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in full-stack product development
  • Strong expertise in modern web technologies and backend systems
  • Proven experience working in an English-speaking team
  • Ability to learn quickly, work autonomously, and maintain a high level of attention to detail
